designer.binding.vizMapping.labelFieldHi: Text shown next to each node.
designer.binding.vizMapping.parentIdFiel: Optional — links child nodes to their parent for hierarchy.
designer.binding.vizMapping.timeline.des: Each API row becomes one event on the timeline. Map title and start date; end date is optional for open-ended events.
designer.binding.vizMapping.endDateHint: Optional — leave empty for point-in-time events.
designer.binding.vizMapping.kanban.descr: Flat card rows are grouped by the column/status field into swimlanes. Define column order below so columns appear in the right sequence.
designer.binding.vizMapping.cardColumnHi: API field whose value determines which column a card belongs to.
designer.binding.vizMapping.columnOrderH: Match the status values your API returns (e.g. todo, doing, done).
designer.binding.vizMapping.columnOrderE: Optional — without column order, columns appear in the order values are first seen in data.
designer.binding.vizMapping.sheet.descri: Each API row becomes one spreadsheet row. Pick API fields for columns; header text is what users see in the sheet header.
designer.binding.chartFilters.hint.descr: When end users change a filter, the value is sent as a query parameter on your list endpoint and the chart reloads automatically. Pick param names that your API already supports.
designer.binding.chartFilters.runtimeEna: Allow end users to change filters at runtime
designer.binding.chartFilters.dropdownHi: Fixed choices the user picks from (e.g. status, region).
designer.binding.chartFilters.optionsEmp: Add at least one value and label (e.g. active → Active).
designer.binding.autoForm.title: Build form from API
designer.binding.autoForm.subtitle: Generate a fully wired form from an API endpoint, then refine it in the designer.
designer.binding.autoForm.step.api.title: API
designer.binding.autoForm.step.api.descr: Pick the API endpoint to build the form from.
designer.binding.autoForm.step.fields.de: Choose which fields to include and how each looks.
designer.binding.autoForm.step.layout.de: Name the form, set its layout and save behavior.
designer.binding.autoForm.step.review.de: Review and generate the form in the designer.
designer.binding.autoForm.validation.end: Select or type an API endpoint before continuing.
